ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in practical electronics accessories than adding a voice assistant.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming would complement my TV, but I would choose the HD option for my 720p screen this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Seagate Expansion 16TB External Hard Drive HDD - USB 3.0, with Rescue Data Recovery Services (STKP16000402); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Storage interests me, but 16TB feels excessive for my current memory-card and camera needs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Gaming Bundle with Fire TV Stick 4K Max and Luna Controller; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for a gaming controller or a game-streaming bundle.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My power-strip purchases were practical additions, and I do not currently need voice-controlled outlets.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My tablet already covers my portable screen needs, and I am not seeking a smart display.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K, brilliant 4K streaming quality, TV and smart home controls, free and live TV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: TV streaming appeals to me, but I would pick one HD stick rather than this 4K option.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Video Doorbell | Two-way audio, HD video, motion and chime app alerts, and Alexa enabled — wired or wire-free (White); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Home-entry monitoring is not a need reflected in what I am shopping for right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart speaker does not address my current camera, storage, or device-accessory needs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my 720p TV; HD suits that screen, assuming it has a free HDMI port.
